resources.string: On the CalZone website, open Devices and choose Show a sign-in code. Then scan it here, or open it with your camera app.
Point the camera at the QR code on the Devices page.
No camera? Copy the address under the code into this phone.
This server does not use https. Use it only on your own network.
That is not a CalZone sign-in code.
This code is used up or has expired. Show a new one on the Devices page.
The server could not be reached. Check the address and that this phone is online.
Signing in did not work. Try a new code.
Android shows CalZone no network, so it holds every sync without saying so. If other apps are online, turn on CalZone\'s Network permission in its app settings.
The server no longer knows this phone (it was removed on the Devices page, or the account was disabled). Your changes on this phone are kept; sign in again to send them.
Show CalZone in your other apps
Allow access to your calendar and contacts so Fossify, widgets, Contacts, the phone app and messengers show your CalZone calendars and address books. What you change there comes back to CalZone.
The last try could not reach the server. It tries again when the phone is online.
When you and someone else changed the same thing, the server kept one. Nothing else was lost.
You deleted it, but someone changed it meanwhile, so it was kept.
Someone deleted it while you changed it, so your change is gone.
You can only view this, so your change was undone.
Something else already uses this item\'s ID, so your change was undone.
The server could not use your change, so it was undone.
The calendar or address book is gone (deleted, or no longer shared with you), and this change with it.
Switch off what this phone should not show in its calendar and contacts apps.
Changes reach this phone within moments.
Off: this phone syncs after your own edits and once a day.
Needs a UnifiedPush app such as ntfy on this phone. Until then this phone syncs after your own edits and once a day.
The server has push turned off. This phone syncs after your own edits and once a day.
Your calendars and contacts leave this phone. Everything stays on the server.
